about:
# SnapPlayerToNearest90
Snaps the player to the nearest mutliple of 90 degrees, much like player rotation behavior in older versions of GD.

<co>Note that this mod has a small chance of breaking your favorite macro bot as this mod changes the player's rotational hitbox.</c>

Mod idea suggested by [MolloPro](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCZ-Sm6ikSOm9MfpqfrF5OZQ) and previously attempted by [AntiMatter](https://github.com/A-Zalt).

This [Geode mod](https://geode-sdk.org) is licensed under LGPLv2. To report bugs or get help with using my mods, press the Discord button in the lower left corner.
